methodology.alternate_hr: Count locked Stage 1 L10 observations strictly greater than each listed alternate threshold; exact-line pushes are not hits; denominator remains 10.
methodology.core_rule: Among listed alternate lines priced -350 through -150 inclusive, select the price closest numerically to -250; ties select the more negative price.
methodology.floor_rule: Immediately lower available threshold than CORE.
methodology.ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available threshold than CORE, regardless of HR.
methodology.candidate_narrowing_rule: Carry forward only when at least one Floor or Core alternate has L10 HR ≥7/10 (70% minimum portfolio evidence threshold). This applies historical eligibility only; no current-week context used for exclusion.
methodology.ordering_rule: QB → RB → WR → TE; within position sort P15 relative to locked Stage 1 current main-market line: above first (smallest positive difference), equal next, below last (closest below first).
methodology.source_note: FanDuel alternate data was unavailable; user-approved DraftKings fallback used. No line movement or cross-book comparison.
